_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::level_set#4. The rule (an initial level-set field that is not a signed distance function must be fixed with REINIT_INITIAL) is confirmed exactly, on the upstream deck built for it: levelset_elliptic_reinit_lin initialises phi = 0.2*x, whose gradient is 0.2 instead of 1, runs elliptic reinitialisation with REINIT_INITIAL: true, and pins the six nodal values of the corrected field phi = x. With REINIT_INITIAL: false all six fail and every computed value is exactly 0.2 times the pinned one -- the solver kept the raw initial field -- which the fixture measures as a ratio rather than asserting. 4C prints no warning about the gradient or the missing signed-distance property. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: keep REINIT_INITIAL on. All six failures and the kept-raw-field count drop to 0, so the fixture must go red.
